args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 3.1.0 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 3.1.0.

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions: <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Fixed in 2.9.4 and 3.1.0.

Since the team has completed the fastjson 3.x migration, this takes the 3.x fix (3.1.0).

CI: passed (run ci-0001).

The PR is open and awaiting review; merging into main requires code-owner approval per policy.
